# POSEIDON GUI Setup Instructions

These instructions explain how to set up and run the POSEIDON fishery agent-based model GUI from the `poseidon-gui` repository.

## Prerequisites

- **Java JDK 8 or later** (tested with Corretto 11, 17, and 21)
- **Git** with submodule support

Verify your prerequisites:

```{bash}
export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 1.8)
java --version
# Should show version 8 (1.8) or later

git --version
# Should show version 2.x or later
```

## Step 1: Clone the repository

```{bash}
git clone https://github.com/poseidon-fisheries/poseidon-gui.git
cd poseidon-gui
```

## Step 2: Fix the submodule URL (SSH → HTTPS)

The submodule is configured with an SSH URL that requires GitHub SSH keys.
Change it to HTTPS:

```{bash}
sed -i.bak 's|git@github.com:poseidon-fisheries/POSEIDON.git|https://github.com/poseidon-fisheries/POSEIDON.git|' .gitmodules
rm -f .gitmodules.bak
git submodule sync
```

## Step 3: Initialize the POSEIDON submodule

```{bash}
git submodule update --init
```

This checks out the POSEIDON library at the specific commit pinned by poseidon-gui.

## Step 4: Fix Java compatibility in POSEIDON

The POSEIDON `build.gradle` requires a Java 8 toolchain, which may not be
available. Replace the toolchain block with source/target compatibility so
any JDK 8+ works:

```{bash}
sed -i.bak '/^java {$/,/^}$/c\
java {\
    sourceCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8\
    targetCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8\
}' POSEIDON/build.gradle
rm -f POSEIDON/build.gradle.bak
```

## Step 5: Fix Java compatibility in poseidon-gui

Apply the same Java compatibility fix to `app/build.gradle.kts`, and
suppress warnings that newer JDKs emit for old Java 8 code:

```{bash}
sed -i.bak '/^java {$/,/^}$/c\
java {\
    sourceCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8\
    targetCompatibility = JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8\
}' app/build.gradle.kts
rm -f app/build.gradle.kts.bak
```

```{bash}
rm -f app/build.gradle.kts.bak
```

## Step 6: Run the GUI

```{bash}
./gradlew :app:run
```

This will compile the POSEIDON library and the GUI app, then launch the
Swing-based POSEIDON GUI.
